findings.description: Bump must cover all three engine manifests (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, .github/plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json), all at 2.12.0 (verified), not just .claude-plugin.
findings.resolution: Plan US-005 now lists all three engine manifests.

findings.description: emitProjections stamps generatedAt with new Date() (emitAgentArtifacts passes none), so whole-file byte-identical checks are unstable.
findings.resolution: Byte-identical assertions target .tasks, not whole files; AC reworded.

findings.description: Add leanTasksJson to templates/overview-config.template.json and document in docs/configuration.md + README (the plugin template schema already lists the existing two).
findings.resolution: Template config + docs/configuration.md + README added to US-004 scope.
Concrete threshold: lean < active-tasks.json AND < 40% of data.json.

findings.description: Prompt present-flag semantics undefined (existence vs non-empty vs truthy).
findings.resolution: present[k] defined as non-empty trimmed string; test all three keys.

findings.description: stripColdBodies early-returns the unmodified task when command is missing, so a command-less task with kanbanCards would leak raw html.
findings.resolution: kanbanCards stripped at task level independently of command presence; command-less-with-cards test case added.

findings.description: scripts/lib/emit-tasks-index.test.mjs exists but is not in the test:lib file list (verified), so a new nav test would not run under npm test.
findings.resolution: US-003 adds the file to the test:lib list in package.json.

findings.description: tools/overview-viewer/src/__tests__/scripts.d.ts duplicates RalphOverviewConfig.outputs and lacks projection keys (verified exists).
findings.resolution: Backfill that duplicate type added to US-002.

findings.description: README ('two lazy read projections') and docs/configuration.md outputs table are underspecified.
findings.resolution: README + docs/configuration.md added to US-004 scope.

findings.description: Codex reported the consumer .ralph-overview/config.json / .ralph/overview-config.schema.json missing under ai-developer-toolkit.
findings.resolution: False positive: codex ran from the plugin-dir cwd; the files exist at the codexu REPO ROOT (verified). Plan states consumer paths explicitly.

findings.description: INDEX.md scope-nav links break for task IDs containing '/', '.', etc., because plain '## id' headings have no stable explicit anchors.
findings.resolution: US-003 requires an explicit, tested anchor scheme covering punctuation + multi-scope IDs.
